specification.title: Cycle and duplicate-discovery bounded termination end-to-end
specification.description: A domain with shared hosting infrastructure whose CNAME branch and MX neighbor re-discover the already-investigated resolved IP and the same shared network prefix. The production Coordinator must suppress duplicate provider work and duplicate entity investigations, terminate boundedly, and persist a clean terminal state and report.
specification.purpose: Verify cycle/duplicate suppression in the production end-to-end path: rediscovery of already-investigated entities never re-executes provider work or pivots, and the investigation terminates cleanly within the authored bounds.
specification.operational_relevance: Shared hosting and mail/name infrastructure routinely create rediscovery potential; unbounded duplicate work is a cost and correctness hazard.
specification.regression_risk: The Coordinator could re-investigate an already-investigated entity discovered through a second path, re-run provider work, or fail to terminate within the authored depth/action bounds.

required: The investigation terminates completed with a final Assessment
Rediscovered entities never trigger duplicate provider work or duplicate investigation
A clean persisted report preserves the final Assessment verdict
forbidden: Duplicate provider work on the same provider and entity
Duplicate investigation of the same entity
Execution beyond the authored depth bound
